hypothesis: Test sgd at initial rate 0.01 against the same-architecture BatchNorm/Adam reference.
test_policy: Training and original validation only; do not load test images or use test metrics.
comparison_note: Follow-up after the closed 45-minute search. Single seed 2112; no second-seed trials. BatchNorm, ReLU, two convolution layers, batch64, weighting, epoch/time caps held fixed. AdamW also introduces explicit decay; SGD has two candidate rates.
stopping_rule: At most 30 epochs, five non-improving validation macro-F1 epochs, or 300 seconds checked between epochs. Final checkpoint verification and training-fit evaluation can add overhead.
